test_cases.name: orphan_heading_moves
test_cases.input: Section heading sits alone at the bottom of a PDF page with the paragraph on the next page
assertions: heading is moved to the next page with at least two lines of the following paragraph

test_cases.name: unrendered_subscript_and_slash
test_cases.input: Visible page contains I_tot and a/b instead of compiled glyphs
assertions: both tokens are recompiled to a plate or Unicode before delivery

test_cases.name: url_solidus_allowed
test_cases.input: Page contains https://digitalmarketingco.org and the prose solidus and/or, and no math source
assertions: scan_unrendered_ops.py does not flag the URL or and/or
